That's One Big Pokémon]]'' as a {{p|Sobble}}. It was first seen as a passenger on [[Professor Magnolia]]'s trailer car. In ''[[PASS03|Crackle!! Practice Battle]]'', {{Henry}} and {{Casey}} fought a trio of {{p|Drednaw}} that gave the trailer car a flat tire. When Sobble wandered onto the battlefield, it was attacked by a Drednaw, causing it to cry. Sobble's tears made Drednaw cry as well, leaving it open to be taken down by Henry's [[Twiggy]]. Afterward, the group noticed that Sobble had taken a liking to [[Marvin]] and suggested he catch it. Marvin happily accepted and added Sobble to his team, later giving it the nickname Sniffler. In ''[[PASS08|Toasty!! Battle Against Toxapex]]'', Sniffler was used to train with [[Twiggy]] to prepare for Henry's Gym battle with [[Nessa]]. Though Marvin cut the battle short, Twiggy gained enough experience to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a {{p|Thwackey}}. In ''[[PASS16|Rising!! Opal of Ballonlea]]'', Sniffler evolved into a {{p|Drizzile}} during a training session for Henry's upcoming Gym battle with [[Opal]]. With its newly-obtained ability to create exploding water balloons, Sniffler helped Henry devise a strategy for avoiding Opal's [[Gigantamax]] {{p|Alcremie}}'s attacks. In ''[[PASS18|Chomp!! It's Dracovish]]'', the group traveled to [[Route 9 Tunnel]], where a {{p|Dracovish}} had been reported to have [[Dynamax]]ed despite the area not being a Power Spot. They found Dracovish being attacked by several Trainers under orders to either catch or get rid of it. With quick thinking and Sniffler's tears, Marvin kept the Trainers distracted long enough for him to catch Dracovish and escape. At Henry and Casey's suggestion, he decided to keep Dracovish and nicknamed it Draco. In ''[[PASS19|Crunch!! Snowy Battle]]'', Sniffler was used to battle [[Gordie]]'s {{p|Stonjourner}}, but the battle was called off when Casey mistook Gordie for an attacker. She borrowed Sniffler and Twiggy and had them team up with her [[Bit|Raboot]] to create a combination attack that took down Stonjourner. Afterward, the misunderstanding was cleared up. In ''[[PASS34|BAAM!! Incredible Evolution of the Three Pokémon]]'', while Henry was training [[Arman|Kubfu]], it got overwhelmed by a group of wild {{p|Skwovet}} and {{p|Greedent}}. Sniffler, alongside Twiggy and Bit, protected it from the Greedy Pokémon. All three evolved during the fight. In ''[[PASS37|Crackle!! Retrieve the Sword & Shield]]'', Sniffler was used to battle a {{rf|Galarian}} {{p|Moltres}}. After it was revealed that Moltres was not a {{type|Fire}}, it was switched in for Draco. In ''[[PASS41|Shing!! Final Form]]'', Sniffler was given [[Max Soup]] and gained the ability to [[Gigantamax]]. It was then [[traded]] to [[Hop]] so the Secret Agent Pokémon could be Gigantamaxed to battle a Gigantamaxed {{p|Kingler}}, {{p|Orbeetle}}, and {{p|Sandaconda}} that were protecting {{p|Eternatus}}. With the help of Twiggy, Bit, and [[Bede]]'s {{p|Hatterene}}, they were able to distract them long enough for {{p|Zacian}} and {{p|Zamazenta}} to attack the Gigantic Pokémon directly. It was traded back to Marvin in ''[[PASS43|Fwoom!! Goodbye, Galar]]''. ==Personality and characteristics== As a Sobble, Sniffler was a sensitive Pokémon, often seen crying and frightened. It lost these traits after evolving, becoming much more stoic.
